name: hello-aflt-improve
goal: Continue eval-gated improvement rounds on an existing tile-dungeon repo that already has the M5a harness (scripts/eval + eval/history.jsonl baseline). At most 3 improve rounds via plan-next; stop on plateau, regression-after-revert, overall >= 99, or 3 rounds. Zero-dependency Node ESM; default PORT 8792.
acceptance: At most 3 improve rounds applied. Each round uses the portable improve-gate.js (definition-dir resolved) that measures overall before and after itself. Suite stays green. Locked scripts/eval/eval.js and scripts/eval/scorer.js untouched. Local commits per passed improve phase allowed; no remotes, no push.
